messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming endpoints (/v1/stream/*). Region: eu-west-1 & us-east-1. Symptoms: stalled SSE chunks + large inter-chunk gaps. Customers showing errors: live-chat (partial degrad), voicebot (time-outs). Paging oncall @sam-oncall. Incident ID: INC-5201112223 :rotating_light:

sam-oncall: on it. I’m starting a quick triage. Any recent deploys or config pushes?

maya-eng: no prod deploys from runtime team in last 2h. I see a config roll from edge-proxy team ~30m ago (conn-window increase).

liam-sre: linking metrics: high proxy write latency and increased TCP retransmits on loadbalancer. p95 token throughput looks fine, p99 spike focused on streaming tails.

jess-support: customers reporting long pauses mid-response, some clients reconnecting. Escalated from CS for live-chat — they see partial transcripts missing.

oliver-runtime: can we confirm KV-cache pressure? If KV eviction spikes, streaming tails can stall due to hot cache thrashing. Pulling cache metrics now.

maya-eng: KV hit-rate stable. But proxy connection queue depth jumped; observed many TIME_WAIT sockets + slow write system calls.

sam-oncall: first mitigation: increase proxy keepalive and shorten upstream write buffer flush interval. Also enabling connection-side backpressure detection to kick slow clients. Applying change to eu-west-1 first.

liam-sre: noted. Rolling change to eu-west-1 now. If that drops p99 we can roll to us-east. Also enabling more aggressive socket-level timeouts for slow consumers (evict after 60s idle).

oliver-runtime: sending a quick-hotfix to stream-flusher to flush partial chunks more frequently (reduce aggregation window from 500ms -> 100ms) to avoid apparent stalls. Deploying to canary.

nora-pm: ETA to canary roll? Customer comms: should we notify live-chat SRE that we’re applying changes?

sam-oncall: canary in 3m. Jess please ping live-chat SRE now that we have a mitigation plan.

jess-support: pinged live-chat SRE and voicebot eng. They want status updates every 5m.

liam-sre: canary shows immediate drop in p99 for streamed chunk gaps in eu-west-1. p99 latency down ~65% vs spike. Connection retransmits also trending down.

maya-eng: logs from proxy show many clients with small recv-window (mobile carriers?). We should consider per-client rate limiting on the edge for pathological small-window clients.

oliver-runtime: runtime can add a soft throttling policy for tiny windows, but that’s medium-risk. For now I'll keep flusher change and the proxy timeouts.

sam-oncall: rolling flusher + proxy keepalive/timeouts to us-east now. Monitoring.

liam-sre: after roll, both regions p99 improved but a subset of streams still show 30s micro-silences — tracing shows these sessions all proxied through a specific edge pool (edge-pool-7).

maya-eng: isolating edge-pool-7. Traffic steering away to healthy pools for affected customers. Doing gradual drain to avoid reconnect storms.

sam-oncall: good. Jess, update customers that we routed affected lives off edge-pool-7 and applied temporary timeouts + flusher fixes. Mention we’re continuing investigation into root cause (probable proxy stall + slow-client combos).

jess-support: notified both customers with summary and mitigations. They acknowledged, want RCA when available. :white_check_mark:

nora-pm: logging action items: (1) RCA on edge-pool-7 proxy bug (2) investigate small client window population and opt-in throttling (3) consider permanent flusher tuning + config guardrail for future proxy changes.

oliver-runtime: capturing runtime traces and heap/epoll stats from pool nodes. Attaching trace links here: <link suppressed for thread>.

liam-sre: scheduling a post-incident debug session at +2h for deep dive. For now, incident state: mitigated (partial) — customer impact reduced to minor degradation. Keeping this thread open for handoff to follow-up owners.

sam-oncall: handing off to maya-eng and liam-sre for RCA and long-term fixes. I’ll mark oncall clear. Great job team. :thumbsup:

maya-eng: taking ownership of RCA. I’ll post findings and proposed fix plan in #incidents-update later today.

liam-sre: taking ownership of edge-pool-7 diagnostics and LB config audit.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT INC-5201112223 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Handoff: maya-eng, liam-sre. Next update due in 2h.
